steps.name: target is live-capable (real speech and real email), unless rehearsing
1. sign up with email (code delivered to a real mailbox)
2-3. create a notice and start from the first configured voice
4. generate audio (real synthesis in live mode)
steps.detail: 117 ms, 103724 bytes, provider test, 2160 ms of audio

steps.name: 5-6. approve and publish; obtain the permanent link
7. open the link anonymously; audio is revalidated, not cached
8-10. correct 3 PM to 4 PM, regenerate, republish; the same link serves the correction
11a. superseded audio is refused by the application (even with its old ETag)
12-13. withdraw; every public route stops serving the notice
15. recover the workspace with the verified email
steps.detail: original notice and both versions found

steps.name: 16. another account cannot read or change the first account's notice
17. sign out everywhere ends the recovered session

note: The listening gate is a browser attestation; this run approved through the API and does not show that anyone listened. Pronunciation is judged only by docs/LISTENING_REVIEW.md.
